[Sanae Takaichi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanae_Takaichi) succeeded [Shigeru Ishiba](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shigeru_Ishiba) as prime minister on 21 October 2025, following the [2025 Liberal Democratic Party presidential election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_Liberal_Democratic_Party_presidential_election); she is the first woman to serve as prime minister.
